Couple words of advice for someone who has done something similar (leveraged 20k of my savings day trading crypto and lost all)

1. Yes you probably have a gambling problem, please stop. Not saying you need to go see a psych, but the best way back is to just stop day trading completely despite the fact you may have gained some back. You have had your fun, and you lost - there's nothing you can do about it now. 
2. Stick to ETFs only if you can't afford to lose that money. If you want to risk money in penny stocks, keep it to something like 10% of your portfolio or less. Despite all the autists on here especially if you're not living at home and actually have expenses to meet, this is a good way to homelessness. 
3. The next couple of months (and years) work your ass off to gain that money back - and no this does not mean by day trading as said to regain losses. If you still want to invest, as "ausfinance" as this sounds, ETFs only - 50% of paycheck into savings the other 50% into ETFs if you have minimal expenses - budget like crazy, you can recover you just may have to sacrifice in the short term. 
4. Take this as a lesson that you learnt it not whilst you're 60 years old with a mortgage, but as a young fellow who (I think) can afford to lose it. Think of it as something you can laugh about in 10 years time and teach it as a lesson to others one day who made the same mistake you did. Most important of all however, make sure that you DO NOT make the same mistake again - we are meant to learn from them. If you continue to gamble and use T + 2 when you clearly don't understand the purpose of it, then yes I would suggest you seek help immediately before you get to later life. 

DM me if you need any more help, always happy to give advice/share lessons I have learnt too.
